state_convention: Stage0 is the complete native state at clock t immediately before transition(t); when a transition occurs, stage1 is the complete post-transition state at the same t before any mechanics/chemistry. The next stage0 at t+.5 includes the full unchanged native update.
restart_convention: Each short window is a fresh diagnostic ledger origin, seeded from exact native widths/all7fields/completecuts at its saved clock. next_id is inherited from initial_next_id and strictly earlier open events. No binned state or cumulative ledger is substituted.
